sections.title: Add a destination
sections.excerpt: Add a destination | Use Add to open the provider picker, then choose from 15+ client and server platforms (Amplitude, GA4, GTM, Mixpanel, PostHog, Facebook Pixel, TikTok Pixel, custom scripts, and server-side variants).

sections.title: Publish and verify
sections.excerpt: Publish and verify | After saving, publish a test Web Placement and watch the provider dashboard for incoming events (page views, screen changes, actions, checkout steps). If nothing arrives within 30 seconds, recheck the ID or token.
